newsitem.title: UK: UK independent forecasts show end-97 rates 7.03%.
newsitem.headline: UK independent forecasts show end-97 rates 7.03%.

text.p: Official British interest rates are expected to rise to 7.03 percent in the fourth quarter of 1997 from 6.0 percent at present, according to the latest summary of new independent forecasts compiled by the Treasury.
The survey of 32 new forecasts by economists in the City and other institutions showed interest rates are expected to rise to 7.15 percent in the fourth quarter of 1998.
